name: Are hardware and functional adjustments covered under a warranty?

mainEntity.name: Are hardware and functional adjustments covered under a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, our hardware and functional adjustments, as part of our construction services, are typically covered under our standard construction warranty. This ensures that any issues arising from our initial work that require re-adjustment within the warranty period will be addressed by our team. Specific warranty details are outlined in our project contract.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, they are typically covered under our standard construction warranty, with details provided in your project contract.
